stories.headline: Eight DGX Spark nodes run a 753-billion-parameter model with measured topology trade-offs
stories.summary: NVIDIA linked eight DGX Spark systems into a one-terabyte-memory cluster and ran the full 753-billion-parameter GLM 5.3 model. Its published tests show multi-node decode gains and different scaling for switch and ring topologies. The measurements are vendor-run, workload-specific and accompanied by networking, synchronization and memory caveats.
stories.why_it_matters: Engineering teams can use the disclosed topology and measurements to design a bounded cluster trial. Readers should compare switch and ring layouts on their own model, recording decode throughput, synchronization overhead, network utilization, memory headroom and failure behavior.

source.title: Running Frontier-Class AI Models Across 8 NVIDIA DGX Spark Nodes

read_evidence.scope: Reviewed the complete NVIDIA technical article, eight-node architecture, one-terabyte memory configuration, GLM 5.3 deployment, switch and ring results, RoCE tuning, throughput tables and stated topology limitations.

stories.related_coverage: Extends inference operations coverage from scheduling policy to a measured desktop-scale distributed serving configuration.
stories.image_alt_intent: Eight compact AI workstations connected through a high-speed switch, with one large model distributed across them and side-by-side gauges comparing ring and switched decode throughput.

stories.headline: Cohere Rerank 5 adds passage-level context focus and two serving tiers
stories.summary: Cohere introduced Rerank 5 Pro and Fast for enterprise retrieval, including Context Focus output that returns relevant passages from long documents. The company reports leading composite results across 39 of 46 datasets and 187 one-thousand-token documents per second for Fast on an A100. These evaluations and the RCP-nDCG metric are publisher-developed.
stories.why_it_matters: Retrieval teams can test whether passage-level output reduces downstream context without losing answer quality. Readers should compare Pro and Fast on representative documents, measuring ranking relevance, passage coverage, latency, throughput, token consumption and performance on parsed tables or scanned pages.

source.title: Introducing Rerank 5: precise, efficient enterprise document retrieval

read_evidence.scope: Reviewed the complete Cohere announcement, Pro and Fast tiers, Context Focus behavior, evaluation methodology, 39-of-46 claim, multilingual and PDF results, throughput measurement, serving options and publisher-evidence limitations.

stories.related_coverage: Updates the evidence-retrieval theme with a different publisher and a passage-return mechanism suitable for controlled context-budget testing.
stories.image_alt_intent: A long enterprise document entering a reranker that highlights only supported passages, with separate Pro and Fast lanes and gauges for relevance, latency and token use.

stories.headline: OpenAI coordinates thousands of agents across a whole-brain CRISPR atlas
stories.focus: Applied Generative AI for Knowledge Workers
stories.summary: OpenAI reports that thousands of distributed agents analyzed millions of cells in a whole-brain CRISPR atlas in 32 minutes, linking gene disruptions with literature and producing an open reasoning atlas. Human experts preferred distributed interpretations to a single-agent baseline. The results generate research leads, not validated biological conclusions, and require laboratory follow-up.
stories.why_it_matters: Research teams can study the workflow as a pattern for dividing evidence-heavy analysis into traceable subtasks, then requiring expert review. Readers should preserve source links, compare against a single-agent baseline and label every synthesized mechanism as a hypothesis awaiting experimental validation.

source.title: Using thousands of AI agents to uncover new leads in biological data

read_evidence.scope: Reviewed the complete OpenAI report, whole-brain CRISPR dataset, distributed-agent architecture, 32-minute run, literature coverage comparison, expert preference evaluation, open reasoning atlas and explicit need for laboratory validation.

coverage_labels: Applied Generative AI for Knowledge Workers
stories.related_coverage: Provides a knowledge-work case where agent scale expands literature synthesis while domain experts retain responsibility for interpretation.
stories.image_alt_intent: A scientific workflow with many small analysis agents examining a brain-cell atlas and literature library, converging on a review table where human researchers mark hypotheses for laboratory validation.

stories.headline: Volkswagen expands Copilot access across 330,000 employees and tracks active agent use
stories.focus: Applied Generative AI for Knowledge Workers
stories.summary: Microsoft says Volkswagen Group has made Copilot available to more than 330,000 employees, with 300,000 monthly active chat users and 26,000 agents active in the prior month. The phased program spans engineering, production, procurement and sales, with a planned Fabric data foundation. All adoption and workflow claims are vendor-and-customer reported.
stories.why_it_matters: Enterprise leaders can borrow the phased rollout pattern without treating access counts as productivity proof. Readers should pair adoption metrics with workflow-level measures such as review time, error rates, source quality, user retention and escalation frequency before expanding agents across additional functions.

source.title: Microsoft empowers more than 330,000 Volkswagen Group employees with Copilot

read_evidence.scope: Reviewed the complete Microsoft Source case study, access and monthly-use figures, 26,000 active agents, phased functional rollout, planned Fabric foundation, named use cases and absence of independently measured outcome evidence.

coverage_labels: Applied Generative AI for Knowledge Workers
stories.related_coverage: Adds large-scale adoption evidence while keeping access and activity separate from independently verified quality or productivity outcomes.
stories.image_alt_intent: A global automotive organization map connecting engineering, production, procurement and sales teams to Copilot, with separate counters for access, monthly chat use and active agents beside an outcome-measure checklist.

stories.headline: ServiceNow Arc brings a governed personal enterprise agent to ordinary office work
stories.summary: ServiceNow announced general availability of Arc, a personal enterprise agent that works across ServiceNow, email and Teams and can plan, check and adjust tasks. The company describes policy enforcement through Control Tower and NVIDIA OpenShell, while several passport and hardware controls remain forthcoming. Availability starts on Mac, with Windows promised within weeks.
stories.why_it_matters: Operations managers can pilot one low-risk coordination task by naming allowed sources, approval points and prohibited actions before connecting the agent. Readers gain a noncoding test for whether policy controls, audit history and human handoffs remain visible across familiar workplace applications.

source.title: ServiceNow delivers industry-first personal enterprise agent and policy enforcement with NVIDIA, extending AI governance across software and silicon

read_evidence.scope: Reviewed the complete ServiceNow release, Arc availability, cross-application workflow, planning behavior, Control Tower and OpenShell controls, Mac and Windows timing, future AI Passport details and forward-looking statement limitations.

stories.related_coverage: Extends consumer-agent permission coverage into governed workplace coordination across ordinary communication tools.
stories.image_alt_intent: An operations manager reviewing a cross-application task plan spanning email, Teams and ServiceNow, with visible policy gates, an audit trail and a human approval handoff.

audience_fit.intended_user: An operations manager who coordinates requests, approvals and follow-ups through email, Teams and service workflows.
audience_fit.practical_action: Choose one low-risk coordination task and list the sources Arc may read, actions it may draft and steps requiring approval.
audience_fit.review_action: Inspect the task history, policy decisions and handoffs after each pilot run, then record omissions or unauthorized action attempts.
audience_fit.usable_outcome: A bounded agent pilot with a written permission map, review checklist and decision about whether to expand the workflow.

stories.headline: Metis turns an agent Skill into a short, testable and governed work procedure
stories.summary: Metis Strategy explains how organizations can package a repeated workflow as a portable agent Skill using a concise SKILL.md, supporting templates and explicit output standards. The procedure emphasizes precise naming, minimal instructions, representative tests, version ownership and a registry. Portability still requires platform-specific validation, and enterprise surfaces are at different maturity levels.
stories.why_it_matters: Proposal leaders can convert one recurring review routine into a reusable Skill without programming: define the baseline, write concise instructions, attach approved templates, test normal and awkward cases, compare results, assign an owner and review date, then register the approved version.

source.title: AI agent skills: Beyond the platform

read_evidence.scope: Reviewed the complete Metis Strategy article, SKILL.md structure, description quality, freedom-versus-fragility guidance, supporting assets, evaluation against baselines, version ownership, registry governance, curator role and portability cautions.

stories.agent_skills_evidence: Reusable noncoding procedure: choose one repeated proposal-review workflow and define its current baseline; write a one-page Skill with a precise name, description, required standards and output format; attach approved templates; test representative and awkward cases against the baseline; correct failures; assign an owner, version and review date; then register and pilot the approved Skill before wider reuse.
stories.related_coverage: Materially updates reusable-Skills coverage with an organization-level authoring, evaluation and governance procedure beyond one product interface.
stories.image_alt_intent: A proposal operations leader moving one recurring review routine through seven labeled stages: baseline, concise Skill, templates, edge cases, comparison, ownership and registry approval.

audience_fit.intended_user: A proposal operations leader who maintains review standards, templates and reusable guidance without writing software.
audience_fit.practical_action: Turn one repeated proposal review into a concise Skill with an explicit description, approved references and required output format.
audience_fit.review_action: Test the Skill on representative and awkward proposals, compare results with the existing baseline and correct failures before approval.
audience_fit.usable_outcome: A versioned, owner-assigned and registry-listed Skill ready for a bounded team pilot across supported assistant platforms.
